requirement: Supplier management shall declare its notification keys on the business layer's notification templates (BF-164), each with the event that raises it, the placeholders it offers, its default audience and an English starter template: supplier invited (the invited contact, SUP-001), registration submitted (the buyer owner, SUP-002), supplier request decided (the requester, SUP-142), change outcome per field (the requester, SUP-203), critical change applied (the supplier's primary contact and the buyer owner, SUP-209), bank account changed (the supplier's primary contact and the buyer owner) and bank change announced (the contacts known before the change, SUP-205), information request sent, reminded and escalated (the supplier's contacts, then the buyer owner, SUP-224), section returned (the supplier, SUP-226), possible sanctions match (compliance and the buyer owner, SUP-165), qualification due (the buyer owner and, for a regulated one, the quality unit, SUP-181) and document expiring (the supplier's primary contact and the buyer owner, SUP-041).
rationale: The product knows what happens to its documents; the tenant decides, in its own words, who hears of it (BF-164). A suite's keys and starter templates are the suite's content (ADR-0043).
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant with the eProcurement Suite, When it is provisioned, Then each key of Supplier management exists with its English starter template and its default audience.|Given a supplier's bank account change applied (SUP-205), When it applies, Then the supplier's primary contact and the buyer owner are told in the key's template, and the contacts known before the change get the announcement.|Given a starter template that names a placeholder its key does not offer, When the module's declarations are checked at start, Then the start fails naming the key and the placeholder. (error case)
notes: Was BF-164, the keys and starter templates of Supplier management. Moved at the review of L2, 2026-10-20 (ADR-0043): each product declares its keys and starter templates; BF-164 keeps the mechanism. Extended 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps): the keys of the new areas; the change rejected and bank account changed keys of SUP-022 and SUP-023, retired, are now SUP-203's and SUP-205's. Changed 2026-10-21 at SUP-gaps' review: the requirements that raise its keys in a later slice (SUP-001 and SUP-002, with the supplier side) depend on this declaration, not the reverse, so no requirement depends on one of a later slice (`make prd-check`).

title: Company data in the portal
requirement: The primary contact maintains one company profile in the network (company data, addresses, contacts, bank accounts, documents) and customer-specific data (sites, information requests, customer-required documents) per customer; each profile change is offered to every connected customer, where it becomes a change request from the source network profile change (SUP-201) under that customer's classes, approvals and verification; the supplier sees per customer what awaits approval and each field's outcome (SPX-030).
rationale: Current data without buyer effort.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bank change in the network profile, When submitted, Then every connected customer has a change request for it, each with its own verification.|Given a non-primary contact, When they try to change bank data, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a document expiring for customer A, When the supplier logs in, Then a reminder names customer A.
notes: Was FF-153. Changed 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps, the pack's section 8.2): a profile change becomes a change request in each customer, from the source network profile change; SUP-022 and SUP-023, on which it depended, are retired into SUP-201 to SUP-211 and SUP-162 to SUP-164.

title: Questionnaires and documents in the portal
requirement: Suppliers answer questionnaires and upload required documents with expiry dates; the portal shows what is missing for publishing.
rationale: Onboarding completeness.
acceptance_criteria: Given a missing mandatory document, When the home page loads, Then it is listed as a to-do.|Given a questionnaire submitted, When viewed, Then it is read-only with status.|Given an expired document, When replaced, Then the block lifts. (edge)|Given a document uploaded with an expiry date in the past, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)
notes: Was FF-157. Retired 2026-10-21 (SUP-gaps): the supplier's side of information collection is SIM's responding, in the portal or by a one-time verified link (the pack's section 8.3, gap G13). Replaced by SUP-225, SPX-008 and SPX-029.
